connector.name: Cron MCP by Shreyas-Profile
connector.registryDescription: Cron-as-a-service MCP. Schedule prompts; when the cron fires we POST to your callback URL.
connector.summary: Hosted at cron.regiq.in over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the shreyas-profile account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <apiKey> — get yours at https://cron.regiq.in after Google sign-in.
